Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the search results, hallucinating a non-existent series called "Glory Days" as the answer. The search results explicitly mentioned "Glory Days" only as a header or a snippet title, while the actual content from Wikipedia and Fandom clearly stated that Rose McGowan was best known for "Charmed" (playing Prue Halliwell). The agent incorrectly prioritized the misleading header text over the factual content of the search snippets, leading to a false conclusion.
